<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Did you hear that?
A <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Now, I know that sounds crazy...
Telling a lie in a class trial?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But...sometimes telling a lie is
<CLT=cltSTRONG>necessary to reach the truth<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Oh, but don't worry. There are no
lies in this tutorial.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>From here on out, there will be times
in a debate you have to <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Before, you had to refute the lies...
But now, you'll have to <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltSYSTEM> yourself.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Doesn't that get your heart pumping?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Here's how it works.
Select a Truth Bullet like normal Nonstop Debates...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But when you hold <PAD=【△】>, the Truth Bullet will
become a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Lie Bullet<CLT=cltSYSTEM> with the <CLT=cltSTRONG>opposite meaning<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Releasing <PAD=【△】> will shoot the Lie Bullet.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When you use a Lie Bullet to argue or
agree with someone's statement...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>It will become a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Perjury<CLT=cltSYSTEM>,
a statement that paints over the truth with lies.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>While <CLT=cltSTRONG>lying<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Influence Gauge<CLT=cltSYSTEM> will drain.
A <CLT=cltSTRONG>successful<CLT=cltSYSTEM> lie will <CLT=cltSTRONG>restore<CLT=cltSYSTEM> it.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But if you miss with your Lie Bullet, you will
<CLT=cltSTRONG>take damage<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, so be careful!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Also, I've heard a rumor that there's a
secret way to advance debates...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>It's called a <CLT=cltSTRONG>back route<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Let's just say that only those who
lie well will be able to find it.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Thank you muchly!
